group.passage: This weekend, the Old Street Toy Festival invites families to try the games that their grandparents played as children. Here are the six traditional toys you will find at the festival, with a short note on how each one is played.

passage_parts.label: A
passage_parts.title: Spinning Top
passage_parts.text: A wooden top has a metal point at the bottom. Wind a string tightly around it, then throw it hard at the ground while pulling the string back. A good throw can make the top spin for a long time. In some games, players try to knock other tops over.

passage_parts.label: B
passage_parts.title: Diabolo
passage_parts.text: This toy from China looks like two cups joined at the bottom. Hold two sticks that are tied together by a string, and roll the diabolo along the string. As it spins faster, it begins to hum. Skilled players can toss it high into the air and catch it again.

passage_parts.label: C
passage_parts.title: Bamboo Dragonfly
passage_parts.text: This simple toy is a thin piece of bamboo with a small stick in the middle. Hold the stick between your hands and rub them quickly, then open your hands. The toy flies straight up, just like the blades of a helicopter. You can play with it by yourself in any open space.

passage_parts.label: D
passage_parts.title: Jianzi
passage_parts.text: A jianzi has colorful feathers on top and a small, heavy bottom. Players kick it into the air and try to keep it from falling to the ground. They can use their feet, knees, or other parts of the body, but never their hands. It can be played alone or in a circle with friends.

passage_parts.label: E
passage_parts.title: Marbles
passage_parts.text: Marbles are small glass balls, often with bright colors inside. Players draw a circle on the ground and take turns shooting their marbles with a thumb. If you knock another player’s marble out of the circle, you can keep it. You need at least one other player for this game.

passage_parts.label: F
passage_parts.title: Iron Hoop
passage_parts.text: Children push a metal hoop along the ground with a stick that has a hook at one end. The trick is to keep running behind the hoop so that it does not fall over. You can race against friends or simply practice by yourself.

At the festival, children can make a bamboo dragonfly fly up by [[1]] their hands together quickly with its stick in between. With an iron hoop, they must keep [[2]] behind it and push it with a stick so that it stays up.

At the festival, children can make a bamboo dragonfly fly up by [[1]] their hands together quickly with its stick in between. With an iron hoop, they must keep [[2]] behind it and push it with a stick so that it stays up.

Lily, a nine-year-old girl, wants a toy that she can play with by herself. Her mother also tells her not to choose any toy that uses a string. Which toys are good choices for Lily?
請選出條目前的英文大寫字母（如 A、B、C 等），並劃記在答題卷作答區內。（多選題，4分）
In B (Diabolo), which verb means “to make a low, steady sound like a busy bee”?（簡答題，2分）

1.explanation_zh: C（竹蜻蜓）說 Hold the stick between your hands and rub them quickly（把竹棒夾在兩手之間，快速搓手），竹蜻蜓就會往上飛。空格前是介系詞 by（by + V-ing：藉由做某事），所以 rub 要改成 rubbing，雙子音 b 要重複。同一句的 hold、open 放進去都不對：hold／open their hands together quickly 不會讓竹蜻蜓飛起來。
evidence: Hold the stick between your hands and rub them quickly, then open your hands.
1.strategy_zh: 用 bamboo dragonfly、stick、hands、quickly 回到 C 找「兩手怎麼動」；by 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。
hints: 空格前是介系詞 by：要填動名詞（V-ing）。
回到 C（Bamboo Dragonfly）：把竹棒夾在兩手之間以後，兩手要快速做什麼動作？
原文 ___ them quickly；把這個動詞改成 V-ing（注意字尾子音要重複）。

2.explanation_zh: F（滾鐵環）說 The trick is to keep running behind the hoop so that it does not fall over（訣竅是一直跟在鐵環後面跑，它才不會倒）。keep 後面接 V-ing，原文就是 running，照抄即可。A 的 pulling、F 的 push 放進 keep ___ behind it 都說不通：拉繩子是陀螺的玩法，推是用棍子推，人要做的是跟在後面跑。
evidence: The trick is to keep running behind the hoop so that it does not fall over.
2.strategy_zh: 用 iron hoop、behind、stays up 回到 F；keep 後面接 V-ing，這一格可以照抄原文。
hints: 空格前是 keep：要填 V-ing。
回到 F（Iron Hoop）：玩鐵環的訣竅是什麼？人要一直在鐵環後面做什麼？
原文 keep ___ behind the hoop；照抄這個 V-ing。

3.explanation_zh: Lily 的條件有兩個：一個人能玩、不能用到繩子。C 竹蜻蜓只有竹片和竹棒，可以自己在空地玩（by yourself）；D 毽子用腳踢、可以一個人玩（alone）；F 鐵環用帶鉤的棍子推，可以自己練習（by yourself）。三個都符合。A 陀螺要把繩子纏在上面、B 扯鈴的兩根棍子用繩子連著，都用到繩子；E 彈珠雖然不用繩子，但至少要有另一位玩家。
evidence: You can play with it by yourself in any open space.
It can be played alone or in a circle with friends.
You can race against friends or simply practice by yourself.

option_notes_zh.A: 陀螺要先用繩子緊緊纏住再甩出去（Wind a string tightly around it），用到繩子，違反媽媽的規定。
option_notes_zh.B: 扯鈴是在兩根用繩子連著的棍子上滾動（tied together by a string），用到繩子，違反媽媽的規定。
option_notes_zh.E: 彈珠不用繩子，但文中明說至少需要另一位玩家（You need at least one other player），Lily 不能一個人玩，只符合一個條件。

3.strategy_zh: 條件配對題：先把題目的條件列出來（①一個人玩 ②不用繩子），再逐條核對每則介紹，兩個條件都符合才選。A、B 單看「一個人能不能玩」好像可以，E 單看「不用繩子」也符合，但都要對照另一個條件才排除。
hints: 先找出 Lily 的兩個條件：能一個人玩、不能用到繩子。
逐則找 string 和 by yourself／alone／other player 這些字：哪幾則用到繩子？哪一則需要別人一起玩？
陀螺、扯鈴都用到繩子，彈珠要兩個人以上；剩下的三則都能一個人玩、也不用繩子。

evidence: As it spins faster, it begins to hum.
4.strategy_zh: 依英文定義找字：題目限定 B、限定動詞；定義說「像蜜蜂一樣持續發出低沉的聲音」，找扯鈴轉快時會怎樣。
hints: 要找一個動詞，意思是「發出低沉、持續的嗡嗡聲」。
看 B（Diabolo）：扯鈴轉得越來越快時，會開始做什麼？
答案在 it begins to ___；寫這個動詞。

translation_zh.text:
【引言】這個週末，老街童玩節邀請全家人一起來玩祖父母小時候玩過的遊戲。以下是你在童玩節會看到的六種傳統童玩，每一種都附上簡短的玩法說明。
【A 陀螺】木頭陀螺的底部有一個金屬尖端。把繩子緊緊纏在陀螺上，然後一邊把繩子往回拉，一邊用力把陀螺往地上甩。甩得好，陀螺就能轉很久。有些玩法是要把別人的陀螺撞倒。
【B 扯鈴】這種來自中國的童玩看起來像兩個底部相連的杯子。雙手拿著兩根用繩子連在一起的棍子，讓扯鈴在繩子上滾動。扯鈴轉得越快，就會開始發出嗡嗡聲。技巧好的人可以把它高高拋到空中，再把它接住。
【C 竹蜻蜓】這個簡單的玩具就是一片薄薄的竹片，中間插著一根小竹棒。把竹棒夾在兩手之間快速搓動，然後張開雙手，竹蜻蜓就會直直往上飛，就像直升機的螺旋槳一樣。你可以自己一個人在任何空曠的地方玩。
【D 毽子】毽子上方有彩色的羽毛，底部小小的、很重。玩的人把毽子踢到空中，盡量不讓它掉到地上。可以用腳、膝蓋或身體的其他部位，但絕對不能用手。毽子可以一個人玩，也可以和朋友圍成一圈一起玩。
【E 彈珠】彈珠是小小的玻璃球，裡面常有鮮豔的顏色。玩的人在地上畫一個圓圈，輪流用拇指彈自己的彈珠。如果把別人的彈珠撞出圈外，就可以把它留下來。這個遊戲至少需要另一位玩家。
【F 滾鐵環】孩子們用一根一端有鉤子的棍子，推著金屬圈在地上滾。訣竅是一直跟在鐵環後面跑，它才不會倒下。你可以和朋友比賽，也可以自己一個人練習。

evidence: Hold the stick between your hands and rub them quickly, then open your hands.
1.explanation_zh: 介系詞 by 後接動名詞；竹蜻蜓是雙手夾住小棍快速搓動，rub → rubbing。
